name: IWA Cruiserweight Title
epitaph: X-Pac won the belt in a four-corners match at Sweet Surrender over HBK, Chaos and Mr. Fro Chuck Brown. By Saturday Night Massacre, Chaos is billed the "current Cruiserweight Champ" — an unstaged change of hands — and retains it at Barbed Wire when both challengers no-show, the held record's last-attested champion.

name: IWA European Title
epitaph: X-Pac is the earliest-attested champion, defending against Raven at Sweet Surrender in a Ravens Rules match — Raven wins there, an Evenflow through a table. By Saturday Night Massacre, Chaos is billed the "current... European Champion," an unstaged change of hands, and loses the belt that same night to a masked arrival revealed as Raditz. Freebird Michael Hayes is the attested champion by Barbed Wire, retaining when his own challenger no-shows — a further unstaged transition, and the held record's last-attested champion.

name: IWA Hardcore Title
epitaph: Mankind is the fed's own earliest-attested champion, winning the vacant title from Mad Stoner in a dumpster brawl at "Survivor Series" (18 April 1999). By "Saturday Night Massacre" (14 August 1999) the title had passed to O.G. Chunk, who won it in a four-corners scramble aided by a mystery masked man later revealed as Raditz — Raditz himself takes the belt from Chunk at the fed's next served PPV, "Barbed Wire." The Mankind-to-Chunk handoff is not staged anywhere in the held record.

name: IWA Intercontinental Title
epitaph: DoggFather won the belt vacant in a ladder match at Survivor Series (Badd Ass Billy Gunn and Roaddogg Jesse James running in to help him). Billed a two-time champion by Sweet Surrender — an unstaged loss and regain in between — he loses it there to Steel. By Saturday Night Massacre, Raven is the attested champion, retaining over Ringmaster (Ravens Rules, Sycho Sid and Raditz both factoring into the finish) in an unstaged change of hands from Steel. Sycho Sid wins the title new at Barbed Wire, pinning Chaos after O.G. Chunk is pulled from the scheduled three-way by injury — Raven's own loss of the belt is never itself staged.

name: IWA Stables Title
epitaph: Degeneration-X won the belts vacant from the Dungeon of Doom in a Hell in a Cell at Survivor Series, then lost them to Corporate-SDH at Sweet Surrender in a three-way cell match against House of Pain — President NateDogg fast-counting the pin himself. By Barbed Wire, nWo Turney holds the titles, an unstaged change of hands from Corporate-SDH, and retains them there against a Degeneration-X rematch, Turney elevating Triple H with the Turney Bomb — the held record's last-attested champions.

name: IWA Tag Team Title
epitaph: Mr. Fro Chuck Brown and Mad Stoner won the belts vacant at Survivor Series (a masked figure staged with Sting's own moveset factoring into the finish) and lost them to Shawn Michaels and Orge Lambart at Sweet Surrender off a fan's ringside interference. Turney and Stone Cold Steve Austin are billed "former champions" walking into Barbed Wire, an unstaged reign between the two — Freebird Michael Hayes and Triple H win the vacant titles there, the held record's last-attested champions.

name: IWA World Title
epitaph: Triple H is the earliest-attested champion, defending against Sting at "Sweet Surrender" (27 June 1999) in a steel-cage main event with President NateDogg as special guest referee — Sting dethrones him there, Scorpion Death Drop and a NateDogg fast count. By the fed's own next served broadcast, "Saturday Night Massacre" (14 August 1999), Shawn Michaels is billed as champion against Turney, an undocumented change; Turney in turn is dethroned by Canyon at "Barbed Wire" after a masked-man run-in (revealed as Chaos and Shawn Michaels) let Canyon steal the pin. Three reigns are structured here on staged evidence; the two intervening changes of hands ride the record as unstructured, attested-but-undocumented gaps.
